featured_reviews.review_text:
"I recently ordered books from this place, and I must say, the experience was incredible. To be honest, since it was my first order and I didn’t know them personally, I was a bit skeptical. But they completely won my trust!
The service was professional, and despite my initial doubts, they handled everything perfectly. My order reached my doorstep safely and much faster than I expected. Everything was well-packaged and in great condition.
I want to sincerely thank them for such a reliable service. If anyone is looking for a trustworthy place to buy books, I highly recommend them. You can definitely trust them with your orders. Truly a 5-star experience!"
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Appreciate you sharing your experience. It's always rewarding when first-time customers feel confident and satisfied with the service.

featured_reviews.name: Rohail khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I recently ordered a money bouquet from NS Gift Hub for my future wife, Unaiza, and I cannot thank Ms. Namra enough for her incredible work.

The bouquet was absolutely stunning and was loved by not just Unaiza, but her entire family as well. They were so impressed by the gesture and the thoughtfulness behind it. I truly owe all the credit to Ms. Namra; honestly, this wouldn't have been possible without her dedication and creativity. She puts so much effort into her work, and it shows in every detail.

The service and the way they treat their customers are commendable. Their behavior, nature, and communication are exceptionally good—they are such humble people. Also, they are very fair with their pricing; they charge exactly what their hard work deserves.

A small piece of constructive feedback: I also ordered a gajra to be worn on the hand, but unfortunately, it wasn't as durable and kept breaking. I hope that next time, the quality of the gajra will match the high standard of their other work.

Overall, I highly recommend NS Gift Hub to anyone looking to make their special occasions even more memorable. Thank you once again, Ms. Namra, for making my special day even brighter!"
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Appreciate how much the bouquet meant to you and your family. It's our goal to deliver thoughtful, lasting details in every order.

featured_reviews.name: Rafiya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Would not recommend purchasing this product at all.

Yes, the cloth quality is decent, but that means absolutely nothing when the product itself fails to serve its purpose properly. The sizing/design clearly seems made only for people under 5 feet tall (I'm 5.5"), yet this was nowhere mentioned on the website before purchase. Important details are conveniently hidden while the brand aggressively advertises on Instagram just to push sales.

What makes this worse is that it’s a prepaid-only website, so the company gets your money upfront and then leaves you stranded when there’s an issue. The moment you raise a genuine concern, the response is basically: “our vendor is fixed,” which translates to — we got your money, now deal with it yourself. No refund, no exchange, no actual solution.

For the premium prices they charge, the greed is very obvious. The focus seems to be more on aggressive marketing and collecting payments than providing transparency, accountability, or proper customer support.

Buy only if you’re willing to risk wasting your money on an overpriced product and a company that disappears the moment you need help.

I recently visited Anand Home Store, which is within walking distance from Bhandup Station (West). The shop offers a variety of artifacts, gifting items, and home décor products.
I purchased a wall frame from the store, but shortly after buying it, one side of the frame broke on its own. I reached out to them on WhatsApp, but received no response for a week. When I finally called, I was told they couldn’t help me with the issue. Considering it was a recent purchase, I expected better support. I even tried fixing it myself, but it didn’t work — and still, no assistance from their end.
Based on my experience, I would suggest checking other stores or options before making a purchase here.

Corporate Gifting Is a Strategic Business Tool, Not an Expense?

Corporate gifting is often viewed as a formality or a seasonal obligation. In an increasingly competitive business environment, the right gift can communicate appreciation, professionalism, and long-term intent far more effectively than words.

Corporate Gifting Builds Relationships, Not Just Goodwill
A well-curated corporate gift shows employees, clients, and partners that they are valued beyond transactions. Employee onboarding kits create a sense of belonging from day one, while client appreciation gifts help nurture long-term relationships. The Cost of Poor Gifting Decisions
Generic, last-minute gifts often fail to make an impact and may even dilute brand value. Inappropriate pricing, low-quality products, or irrelevant items can send the wrong message. This is where businesses lose both money and opportunity.
 
Strategic Gifting Requires Expertise
Effective corporate gifting requires clarity on purpose, budget, audience, timing, and brand alignment.
